changelog: Publisher-note release. The Observa private beta is now open for selected n8n and OpenClaw operators. No operational behavior or license changes.
summary: Identifies unaccounted inventory loss in restaurant operations by cross-referencing sales volume against theoretical recipe yields. Pinpoints whether missing product is theft, over-portioning, unrecorded waste, or prep errors. Built by a QSR GM with 16 years in restaurant operations.
